subject: Pilot calendar makeup and extension request — Integrum Labs
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@integrumlabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot - blocking auth error + request for pilot makeup days

Hi Karthik,

We're still blocked on the auth handshake between our SSO provider and your sandbox (we see a 401 in the logs during token exchange). Engineering dug in this morning and found a config mismatch on the redirect URI that's preventing our connector from provisioning new bot users. We've attached the error log and a short screenshot of the console.

Because of this, our calendar for the pilot demo next Wednesday is at risk — we lost two full integration days while we tried config permutations. Given the time sunk on our side, would Redwood be able to grant an additional 21 days on the pilot window and a small pool of sandbox credits so we can run the end-to-end tests once auth is fixed?

Requested:
- Pilot extension: +21 days
- Sandbox credits: ~150k tokens (rough estimate)

We really want to get the demo back on schedule; our PM (ops@integrumlabs.com) is waiting on a firm date. Please let me know if you need anything else (logs, access, or a quick tech sync).

Thanks,
Anika
Anika Rao
Senior Product Manager | Integrum Labs

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Hi Anika — thanks for the quick detail and for sending the logs. I'm sorry this has eaten into your pilot window.

We can support a pilot extension and credits in principle; I'll need a quick signoff from Markus (pricing lead) and Monica (CS) for the exact amounts and timing. Two quick items from my side:
- Can you confirm the earliest date you'd like to reschedule the demo?
- Is the 150k token estimate covering all your end-to-end scenarios (or should we provision a bit extra to be safe)?

I'll loop my team and follow up with a formal approval/terms. Also happy to get an engineer on a 30-min sync today to accelerate root cause if that helps.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Integrum Labs — pilot makeup request (approval needed)

Markus / Monica — forwarding Integrum's ask. TL;DR: integration auth error cost them ~2 dev days; they want +21 days on the pilot window and ~150k token sandbox credit so they can re-run the end-to-end tests and hit the demo date. Deal: DL-2028-271 (mid-market, likely annual commit post-pilot).

Why I think we should approve (recommended):
- High intent: Integrum has engineering capacity to continue once auth is cleared; they signaled timeline urgency for a demo next week.
- Upside: a successful demo likely converts to a Dedicated trial in Q3; losing momentum risks the opportunity.
- Cost: 150k tokens is low relative to expected ARR if they convert.

Proposal for approval:
- Grant a 21-day pilot extension (new end date = original_end_date +21 days)
- Issue 150k sandbox token credit (internal cost estimate ~$1.5k)
- Condition: schedule a 30-min tech sync within 5 business days to verify auth and run a test pass (CS to own)

If you can approve, I will: update the HubSpot deal, add credits to their sandbox, and confirm new demo date with Integrum.

Quoted below:
> From: Anika Rao <anika@integrumlabs.com>
> We're still blocked on the auth handshake between our SSO provider and your sandbox...

Thanks — appreciate a quick yes/no so I can move things forward.

Karthik

From: markus_klein@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integrum Labs — pilot makeup request (approval needed)

Karthik / Monica — approved with a small guardrail. Approve the extension and credits as requested but tighten the conditions to protect cost and momentum.

Approved items:
- Pilot extension: +21 days (from original end date)
- Sandbox credit: 150,000 tokens (grant now)

Conditions / next steps:
1) CS (Monica) to schedule a 30-min tech sync within 5 business days and confirm auth fix; please include one of our infra engineers.
2) If Integrum hasn't run at least one successful end-to-end test within 12 business days of credit issuance, credits will be re-evaluated and may be prorated.
3) Karthik — update HubSpot: Deal DL-2028-271, add note and change pilot end date; add a task for the tech sync. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/Integrum-Labs

Marissa (cc'd) — please coordinate the credit grant in the sandbox and attach the credit memo to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — good call on making this a low-friction fix to keep the momentum.

-Markus Klein
